mechanism.legal_step: Propose archived parent pairs from a deterministic hot/global schedule; score coefficient sums; spend one group addition only on the chosen pair.
mechanism.coverage_state: Bloom sketch contains every exactly covered finite slope; no false negatives in the verified finite runs.
mechanism.planning_scan: One logical sequential scan of all archived coefficient records per step evaluates all candidates in a batch.
mechanism.reason_difference_disabled: The primary experiment stays in the non-inverting generic model; no free negation is assumed.

large_capacity_envelope.quadratic_scan_bytes_for_N_records_formu: 64*N*(N+5) bytes for 128-byte records and N-3 planned additions.

limitations: Candidate-pair generation and Bloom parameters are finite design choices with no optimality proof.
Bloom false-positive formulas assume independent uniform hashes; finite counters are logical, not hardware timings.
Maintaining a no-false-negative all-slope sketch requires quadratic slope generation and archive scanning.
The 1 TB / 100 TB inequalities bound resident records only and do not make quadratic planning traffic feasible.
No novelty, ECDLP speedup, fixed-r rho improvement, hardware feasibility, or production claim.
